snippet.description:

https://x.ea.com/90123
EA SPORTS™ NHL® 27 developers join creator Sleeveless Gaming to answer some of the community’s most asked questions about what is changing this year and what the team is focused on next.

Go deeper on Connected Franchise, including its social-first foundation, commissioner tools, cross-play roster sharing, offline Franchise updates, server selection, and more.
On the ice, the team breaks down 32 unique Team Playbooks powered by NHL EDGE data, Cohesive Teamwork AI, contextual strategy shifts, improved poke checks and stick lifts, L2/LT changes, body contact tuning, and more reactive goaltending.
Learn more about The Orchestrator, authentic arena presentation, goal songs and jumbotron content, plus the new commentary team of John Buccigross and Darren Pang.
Plus, hear what’s changing in World of Chel and Hockey Ultimate Team, including X-Factor balance, progression, HUT quality-of-life updates, Champs rewards, coaches and playbooks, and how the Feedback Portal will help shape future development.
